entities.summary: The National Archaeological Museum of Chiusi is a museum in Chiusi, Siena, Italy. It contains Ancient Greek, Etruscan, Ancient Roman and Lombard items, many of which have been excavated in the surrounding province. The museum also has a restoration laboratory, specializing in archaeological materials.
